_about: Hand marks for all 25 runs, 4 Nov 2026, one entry per run, keyed by route, bot_check, question and run (the run number within that question, 1 here). AXIS ran with --no-score, so no AI grader marked anything: we read each run's full final answer and its tool calls, and marked it against Natalie's answer key and the shared grading rule in questions/README.md. 'Not found' means the agent said it couldn't find the answer; under the shared rule that takes precedence over Wrong. false_statement records anything false an answer stated along the way. q5_count is how many of the 8 chains the answer named, recorded on every Q5 run.

marks.reason: Opened 6 pages, never the USDG page. On live, the only homepage link to /products/usdg-on-arbitrum sits inside the closed Products dropdown (hidden, so not in the page snapshot), and the footer's Products column doesn't list it. The agent searched snapshots by text and never clicked a menu. It said it couldn't find the answer, so the mark is Not found, but it also wrongly said the site doesn't say which programme rewards USDG. We checked the live page on 4 Nov: it exists and the DRIP text is unchanged.
